content: An individualized medical nutrition therapy program, tailored to the specific needs of the patient, should be provided by a registered dietitian nutritionist who has expertise in diabetes care. This is recommended for all individuals diagnosed with type 1 diabetes, type 2 diabetes, prediabetes, or gestational diabetes. Given its potential to reduce healthcare costs and improve cardiometabolic outcomes, medical nutrition therapy should be appropriately reimbursed by insurance providers and other payers to ensure accessibility and implementation.
